title: How Pregnancy Happens
summary: Pregnancy can happen when sperm reaches the vagina — usually through penis-in-vagina sex — and fertilises an egg, which then implants in the uterus. It can happen even without full penetration or ejaculation inside.
key_points: Pregnancy is most likely in the days around ovulation, but sperm can survive up to 5 days.
Oral sex, kissing or touching without semen near the vagina can't cause pregnancy.
A late period plus possible exposure: take a pregnancy test.
